name: foodflow
description: FoodFlow - college canteen ordering and crowd management system

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:mem: concurrently -n mongo,server,client -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run mongo:mem -w server" "npm run dev:mem -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
